# **II. Software Requirement Specification** {#ii.-software-requirement-specification}

## **1\. Product Overview** {#1.-product-overview}

### **1.1 Context Diagram** {#1.1-context-diagram}

StockFlow (Order & Inventory Management System) is an internal web application for Tin Phat Manufacturing Co., Ltd., used on desktop web browsers. Field staff (warehouse checkers, workshop foremen, team leaders and workers) do not use the system: they count goods and report actual quantities on paper, and office staff record these confirmed figures in StockFlow. The system is therefore used by five actors only: Admin, Manager (Chief Accountant), Sales Accountant, Warehouse Accountant and Production Accountant. Customers and suppliers do not access the system. Barcode scanning, mobile devices and integration with external accounting software (MISA) are out of scope.

## **2\. User Requirements** {#2.-user-requirements}

### **2.1 Actors** {#2.1-actors}

| \# | Actor | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | **Admin** | System administrator. Manages employee accounts (create, update, lock, reset password), roles and the functions granted to each role, the warehouses each account may access (data isolation), the warehouse facilities and the order settings. |
| 2 | **Manager** | Office Manager / Chief Accountant. Maintains goods, price books, customers, suppliers, credit limits and BOM formulas; decides credit requests; approves production plans, creates and runs production orders; records receipt and payment vouchers and debt adjustments. The Manager also has all sales, purchasing and warehouse functions. |
| 3 | **Sales Accountant** | Belongs to the Sales department. Records customer orders received by phone, Zalo or in person as bookings, consolidates bookings, issues sales invoices on the POS screen with payment and credit check, sends credit requests, creates sales returns and follows up customer debt. |
| 4 | **Warehouse Accountant** | Belongs to the Warehouse department. Based on the warehouse checkers' count reports, records purchase orders, goods receipts (accepted and defective quantities), purchase returns, supplier payments, stock transfers, stocktakes and inventory disposals. |
| 5 | **Production Accountant** | Belongs to the Production department. Follows production orders and BOM material requirements, records material issues (including supplementary issues) and finished goods receipts based on the count reports, and drafts and submits production plans. |

**Note:** Actors represent business roles, not individual employees. Each employee account is assigned one role by the Admin; its permissions are the functions granted to that role, limited to the warehouses assigned to the account (BR-02, BR-03, BR-04). All five actors share the common use cases Login, Logout and Change Password (generalized as Employee in the common use case diagram).

#### **2.2.2 Use Case Descriptions** {#2.2.2-use-case-descriptions}

| UC-ID | Use Case | Actors | Use Case Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| UC-01 | Login | All users | Allows a user to log in to StockFlow with a username, email or employee code and a password. The system loads the functions of the account's role and the warehouses assigned to the account. |
| UC-02 | Logout | All users | Allows a logged-in user to end the current session. |
| UC-03 | Change Password | All users | Allows a logged-in user to change his or her own password according to the password policy. |
| UC-04 | Manage Accounts | Admin | Allows the Admin to manage employee accounts that are allowed to use StockFlow. |
| UC-05 | View Accounts (extends UC-04) | Admin | Allows the Admin to view the list of employee accounts with their roles, assigned warehouses and status. |
| UC-06 | Search Accounts (extends UC-04) | Admin | Allows the Admin to search and filter accounts by name, employee code, email, role or status. |
| UC-07 | Add New Account (extends UC-04) | Admin | Allows the Admin to create a new employee account, assign its role and the warehouses it may access. |
| UC-08 | Update Account (extends UC-04) | Admin | Allows the Admin to update the information of an existing employee account and reset its password. |
| UC-09 | Activate / Deactivate Account (extends UC-04) | Admin | Allows the Admin to activate or deactivate an account; a deactivated account cannot log in. |
| UC-10 | Manage Roles & Permissions | Admin | Allows the Admin to manage roles and the system functions (permissions) granted to each role. |
| UC-11 | View Roles (extends UC-10) | Admin | Allows the Admin to view the roles and the functions granted to each role. |
| UC-12 | Create / Update Role (extends UC-10) | Admin | Allows the Admin to create a new role or update the name and description of a role. |
| UC-13 | Configure Role Permissions (extends UC-10) | Admin | Allows the Admin to add or remove system functions (permissions) of a role. |
| UC-14 | Assign Roles to User (extends UC-10) | Admin | Allows the Admin to set the role of an employee account in the account form; each account holds one role. |
| UC-15 | Manage Warehouse Access | Admin | Allows the Admin to control which warehouses each employee account can view and operate on. |
| UC-16 | View Warehouse Access (extends UC-15) | Admin | Allows the Admin to view the warehouses currently assigned to each account. |
| UC-17 | Assign Warehouse Access (extends UC-15) | Admin | Allows the Admin to assign or remove one or more warehouses for an account. |
| UC-18 | Manage Pending Orders | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to record and maintain customer orders (bookings) received by phone, Zalo or in person. A booking reserves quantity but does not change inventory. |
| UC-19 | Create Pending Order (extends UC-18) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to create a booking with customer, processing warehouse, products, quantities, unit prices from the price book, expected delivery date and an optional advance payment, without changing inventory. |
| UC-20 | View Pending Orders (extends UC-18) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to view, search and filter bookings by status, customer and time. |
| UC-21 | Update Pending Order (extends UC-18) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to update the products, quantities, prices or information of a booking that has not been delivered yet. |
| UC-22 | Cancel Pending Order (extends UC-18) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to cancel a booking that has not been delivered; an advance payment is either refunded or kept as customer prepayment. |
| UC-23 | Consolidate Orders & Process Sales Invoice | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to consolidate bookings of one customer and one warehouse, and to process a booking into a sales invoice on the POS screen, where the payment is recorded, the credit limit is checked and the stock is issued. |
| UC-24 | Select Orders to Consolidate (included in UC-23) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to select bookings of the same customer and the same processing warehouse and merge them into one booking. |
| UC-25 | Record Customer Payment (extends UC-23) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to record the amount paid by the customer (cash or bank transfer) on the invoice; the advance payment of the booking is deducted first. |
| UC-26 | Generate Payment QR Code (extends UC-25) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to display a bank transfer QR code containing the payment amount and transaction code. |
| UC-27 | Request Credit Approval (extends UC-23) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to send a credit request to the Manager from the POS screen when the expected debt exceeds the customer's credit limit, with a reason and an optional proposed limit. |
| UC-28 | Create Sales Return | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to create a return for goods of a completed invoice, or a quick return without an invoice. The return is completed when it is saved. |
| UC-29 | View Customer Debt | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to view customer debt, credit limit, invoices, receipts and the debt and credit limit history; debt warnings follow the debt-warning settings. |
| UC-30 | Manage Purchase Orders | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to create, view, update, send, merge, finish and cancel purchase orders to suppliers. |
| UC-31 | Process Inbound Goods Receipt | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to record goods received from a supplier, with or without a purchase order, based on the checker's count report. |
| UC-32 | Record Defective / Missing Goods (extends UC-31) | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to record defective quantities separately from accepted quantities; defective goods are not added to inventory and are not paid. |
| UC-33 | Return Goods to Supplier (extends UC-31) | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to return goods of a completed receipt to the supplier as a purchase return; the supplier payable or refund is updated. |
| UC-34 | Allocate Inbound Costs | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to record landed costs (freight, handling...) of a completed receipt and allocate them to the received items. |
| UC-35 | Process Sales Stock Issue | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to issue stock when a sales invoice is completed on the POS screen; inventory is deducted by the quantity on the invoice. |
| UC-36 | Adjust Actual Sales Issue Quantity (extends UC-35) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to deliver only part of a booking; the booking stays in Delivering with the remaining quantity. |
| UC-37 | Process Stock Transfer | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to create a transfer between warehouses, confirm dispatch at the source and receipt at the destination. |
| UC-38 | Record Transfer Discrepancy (extends UC-37) | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the destination warehouse to enter the received quantity of each line; a received quantity lower than the transferred quantity requires a receiving note. |
| UC-39 | Conduct Stocktake | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to create a stocktake, enter the physical counts and complete it; completing the stocktake balances inventory to the counted quantities. |
| UC-40 | Record Stocktake Discrepancy (extends UC-39) | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to see the variance quantity and value of each line calculated by the system and to explain the variance in the stocktake note. |
| UC-41 | Process Customer Returns | Sales Accountant | Allows the Sales Accountant to complete a customer return: returned goods are added back to inventory and the customer debt is reduced or a refund is paid. |
| UC-42 | Categorize Return Items (included in UC-41) | Sales Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to classify each returned item as Restock, Repair or Scrap. |
| UC-43 | Process Inventory Disposal | Warehouse Accountant | Allows the Warehouse Accountant to create a disposal note for damaged or scrap inventory; completing the note deducts inventory at cost. |
| UC-44 | View Production Orders | Production Accountant | Allows the Production Accountant to view production orders, planned and received quantities and status. |
| UC-45 | View Material Requirement & Issue Status | Production Accountant | Allows the Production Accountant to view the BOM-based material requirement, issued quantity and shortage of a production order. |
| UC-46 | Process Material Stock Issue | Production Accountant | Allows the Production Accountant to record raw materials actually issued to the workshop for a production order. |
| UC-47 | Issue Supplementary Materials (extends UC-46) | Production Accountant | Allows the Production Accountant to record additional material issues for the same production order reference. |
| UC-48 | Adjust Actual Material Issue Quantity (extends UC-46) | Production Accountant | Allows the Production Accountant to enter an issued quantity lower than required when stock is insufficient; the shortage is kept. |
| UC-49 | Record Finished Goods Receipt | Production Accountant | Allows the Production Accountant to record finished goods counted by the warehouse checker into the finished goods warehouse. A receipt is also created when the Manager approves the completion of the order. |
| UC-50 | Record Defective Finished Goods (extends UC-49) | Production Accountant | Allows the Production Accountant to record defective or scrap finished goods found during counting, with the reason. |
| UC-51 | Manage Master Data | Manager | Allows the Manager to maintain master data used by all business transactions. |
| UC-52 | Manage Product / Material (extends UC-51) | Manager | Allows the Manager to maintain goods (raw materials, semi-finished and finished goods), categories, selling price, reorder point and images, import goods from a file and view the stock card. |
| UC-53 | Manage Unit / Conversion (extends UC-51) | Manager | Allows the Manager to create units of measure from the goods form and define conversion units of a product. |
| UC-54 | Manage Customer / Supplier (extends UC-51) | Manager | Allows the Manager to maintain customer and supplier information and their active status. |
| UC-55 | Set Credit Limit (extends UC-51) | Manager | Allows the Manager to set or change the credit limit of one or many customers with a reason; every change is kept in the credit limit history. |
| UC-56 | Manage Warehouse & Location (extends UC-51) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view warehouses and storage locations; warehouses are created and updated by the Admin (UC-15). |
| UC-57 | Manage BOM / Material Norm (extends UC-51) | Manager | Allows the Manager to create, version, activate and deactivate the BOM (standard quantity and wastage rate) of each finished good. |
| UC-58 | Manage Production | Manager | Allows the Manager to plan production orders and monitor materials and finished goods. |
| UC-59 | Manage Production Order (extends UC-58) | Manager | Allows the Manager to create, update, cancel, close or approve the completion of a production order; material requirements are calculated from the active BOM and can be adjusted on the order with a reason. |
| UC-60 | Track Production Materials (extends UC-58) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor required, issued and shortage material quantities of production orders. |
| UC-61 | Track Finished Goods Receipt (extends UC-58) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor finished goods received, defective quantities and material usage warnings. |
| UC-62 | Manage Sales & Credit | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor sales, fulfillment and customer debt and to decide credit requests. |
| UC-63 | Track Sales Orders (extends UC-62) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor bookings and sales invoices. |
| UC-64 | Approve Credit Request (extends UC-62) | Manager | Allows the Manager to approve a one-time credit exception, approve a new credit limit or reject a credit request. |
| UC-65 | Track Outbound Fulfillment (extends UC-62) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor delivered and remaining quantities of bookings and the related invoices. |
| UC-66 | View Customer Debt & Overdue (extends UC-62) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view customer debt, credit limit and debt warnings by amount and by number of debt days. |
| UC-67 | Purchasing & Receiving | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor purchase orders, receipts, defective and returned goods, landed costs and supplier payables. |
| UC-68 | Track Purchase Orders & Receipts (extends UC-67) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor purchase orders and their receiving progress. |
| UC-69 | Track Defective / Returned Goods (extends UC-67) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor defective quantities recorded on receipts and goods returned to suppliers. |
| UC-70 | Track Landed Cost & MAC (extends UC-67) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor landed cost allocation and the resulting Moving Average Cost. |
| UC-71 | View Supplier Payable (extends UC-67) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view outstanding amounts payable to suppliers. |
| UC-72 | Manage Inventory | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor inventory and approve inventory adjustments and disposals. |
| UC-73 | View Multi-Warehouse Inventory (extends UC-72) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view inventory quantities per warehouse and the stock card of each product. |
| UC-74 | Track Stock Transfers (extends UC-72) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor transfers and transfer discrepancies. |
| UC-75 | Approve Stocktake Adjustment (extends UC-72) | Manager | Allows the Manager to review stocktake results and approve, reject or request a recount. |
| UC-76 | Approve Inventory Disposal (extends UC-72) | Manager | Allows the Manager to approve or reject an inventory disposal note. |
| UC-77 | View Reorder Point Alerts (extends UC-72) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view items whose on-hand quantity has reached the reorder point. |
| UC-78 | View Expiry Alerts (extends UC-72) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view lots approaching or past their expiry date. |
| UC-79 | Manage Returns | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor customer returns and their handling and financial effect. |
| UC-80 | Track Return Requests (extends UC-79) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor sales returns and purchase returns and their status. |
| UC-81 | Track Restock / Repair / Scrap (extends UC-79) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor how returned items were handled. |
| UC-82 | Track Refund / Debt Adjustment (extends UC-79) | Manager | Allows the Manager to monitor refunds paid on returns and debt adjustments. |
| UC-83 | Manage Finance & Reports | Manager | Allows the Manager to record cash receipts and payments and view management reports. |
| UC-84 | Create Receipt Voucher (extends UC-83) | Manager | Allows the Manager to record money received from a customer; the amount is allocated to unpaid invoices, oldest first, and reduces the customer's debt. |
| UC-85 | Create Payment Voucher (extends UC-83) | Manager | Allows the Manager to record money paid to a supplier; the amount is allocated to unpaid receipts and reduces the supplier payable. |
| UC-86 | View Debt Report (extends UC-83) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view receivable and payable reports. |
| UC-87 | View Inventory Report (extends UC-83) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view inventory quantity, movement and value reports. |
| UC-88 | View Revenue & Profit Report (extends UC-83) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view revenue and gross profit based on MAC. |
| UC-89 | View Cost Report (extends UC-83) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view purchasing, landed and production material cost reports. |
| UC-90 | View Management Dashboard (extends UC-83) | Manager | Allows the Manager to view key indicators and pending approvals on one dashboard. |
| UC-91 | Manage Price Books | Manager | Allows the Manager to create price books with validity period, branch and customer scope, and to set the price of each product directly or by a formula based on cost, last purchase price or another price book. |
| UC-92 | Manage Production Plans | Manager | Allows the Manager to view production plans with their progress (quantity ordered, remaining and received) and to manage their life cycle. |
| UC-93 | Create & Submit Production Plan (extends UC-92) | Production Accountant, Manager | Allows the planner to create or update a production plan (period, finished goods, quantities, receiving warehouse), view the estimated material requirement and submit the plan for approval. |
| UC-94 | Approve / Reject Production Plan (extends UC-92) | Manager | Allows the Manager to approve a submitted plan or reject it with a reason. |
| UC-95 | Create Production Orders from Plan (extends UC-92) | Manager | Allows the Manager to create production orders from an approved plan for the whole or part of the remaining quantity. |
| UC-96 | Close / Cancel Production Plan (extends UC-92) | Manager | Allows the Manager to close a plan when production is finished, or cancel a plan that has no active production order. |
| UC-97 | Configure Order & Debt-warning Settings | Admin, Manager | Allows the Admin to configure order settings (document code rules and prefixes, return period, negative stock, accepting new bookings) and the Manager to configure debt warnings and the default credit limit. |
| UC-98 | Adjust Customer / Supplier Debt | Manager | Allows the Manager to set the debt of a customer or the payable of a supplier to a new value with a description; the adjustment is recorded in the debt history. |
| UC-99 | Import Products & Adjust Stock | Manager | Allows the Manager to import goods from an Excel file and to adjust the stock of a product in a warehouse; the adjustment is recorded as a balanced stocktake. |

#### **2.2.3 Use Case Specifications** {#2.2.3-use-case-specifications}

##### **2.2.3.1 UC-01 Login**

| ID and Name | UC-01: Login |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | QuanDN | **Date Created:** | 03/11/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Admin, Manager, Sales Accountant, Warehouse Accountant, Production Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | A user wants to access StockFlow. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows an employee to log in with a username (or email or employee code) and a password. After login, the system shows only the functions granted to the role of the account and only data of the warehouses assigned to the account. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | The user has an employee account created by the Admin. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The user is authenticated, a session token is issued and the first screen permitted to the user's role is displayed. **Failed:** The user is not logged in and the login screen remains displayed. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. User opens the StockFlow login screen. 2\. User enters the username (or email or employee code) and the password. 3\. User clicks Login. 4\. System validates the credentials and the account status. (See E1.1, E1.2) 5\. System loads the role, the permitted functions and the assigned warehouses of the account. 6\. System issues the session token and displays the first screen permitted to the role. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A1.1: Session still valid** 1\. The user opens StockFlow while the session token is still valid. 2\. System opens the application directly without the login screen. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E1.1: Invalid credentials** 1\. Cause: The username or password is incorrect. 2\. Response: System displays an error message without telling which field is wrong (MSG02). 3\. The user stays on the login screen. **E1.2: Inactive account** 1\. Cause: The account has been locked by the Admin. 2\. Response: System displays a message that the account is inactive (MSG03). 3\. The user cannot log in. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-04, BR-05 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.2 UC-02 Logout**

| ID and Name | UC-02: Logout |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.3 UC-03 Change Password**

| ID and Name | UC-03: Change Password |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | QuanDN | **Date Created:** | 03/11/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Admin, Manager, Sales Accountant, Warehouse Accountant, Production Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | A logged-in user wants to change his or her password. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows a logged-in user to change his or her own password. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | The user is logged in and the account is not locked. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The new password is saved; the old password can no longer be used. **Failed:** The password is not changed. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. User selects Change Password in the header menu. 2\. System displays the change password popup. 3\. User enters the current password, the new password and the confirmation. 4\. User clicks Update Password. 5\. System validates the current password and the password policy. (See E3.1, E3.2) 6\. System saves the new password as a salted hash. 7\. System displays a success message (MSG08). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A3.1: Cancel** 1\. User clicks Cancel. 2\. System closes the popup without changing the password. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E3.1: Wrong current password** 1\. Cause: The current password is incorrect. 2\. Response: System displays an error message (MSG06). 3\. The password is not changed. **E3.2: Invalid new password** 1\. Cause: The new password does not meet the policy, is the same as the current password, or does not match the confirmation. 2\. Response: System highlights the invalid field (MSG07). 3\. The password is not changed. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | Medium |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-05 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.4 UC-04 Manage Accounts**

| ID and Name | UC-04: Manage Accounts |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | QuanDN | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Admin |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | The Admin needs to create, view, update, lock or unlock an employee account. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Admin to manage the employee accounts that are allowed to use StockFlow, including the role and the warehouses of each account. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Admin is logged in. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The account information is saved and applies at the next request of that account. **Failed:** The system displays an error message and the account is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Admin opens Employees. 2\. System displays the account list with employee code, name, contact, role, assigned warehouses and status. 3\. Admin selects the required operation. (See A4.1 – A4.5) 4\. System processes the operation and refreshes the list. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A4.1: Search accounts** 1\. Admin enters a keyword (name, employee code, email) and selects a status or role filter. 2\. System displays the matching accounts. **A4.2: Add new account** 1\. Admin clicks Add Employee. 2\. Admin enters full name, username, phone, email, job title, role, warehouses and an optional employee code. 3\. System validates the data (See E4.1, E4.2) and saves the account with the default password. **A4.3: Update account** 1\. Admin opens an account and changes its information, role or warehouses. 2\. System validates and saves the changes. **A4.4: Lock / unlock account** 1\. Admin clicks Lock or Unlock and confirms. 2\. System changes the status; a locked account loses all permissions at its next request. **A4.5: Reset password** 1\. Admin selects Reset Password and confirms. 2\. System sets the password of the account to the default password. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E4.1: Duplicate data** 1\. Cause: The username, email or employee code already exists. 2\. Response: System displays a duplicate message (MSG09). 3\. The account is not saved. **E4.2: Invalid data** 1\. Cause: A required field is empty, the email format is invalid or the Admin role is selected. 2\. Response: System highlights the invalid fields (MSG01). 3\. The account is not saved. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-03, BR-04, BR-05, BR-49 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.5 UC-10 Manage Roles & Permissions**

| ID and Name | UC-10: Manage Roles & Permissions |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | QuanDN | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Admin |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | The Admin needs to create a role or change the functions granted to a role. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Admin to manage roles and the functions (navbar features and the module permissions derived from them) granted to each role. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Admin is logged in. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The role and its functions are saved and apply at the next request of the accounts holding the role. **Failed:** The system displays an error message and the role is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Admin opens Roles. 2\. System displays the roles with the number of accounts of each role. 3\. Admin selects the required operation. (See A10.1 – A10.3) 4\. System saves the change and displays a success message (MSG13). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A10.1: Create / update role** 1\. Admin enters the role name, role code (prefix ROLE\_) and description. 2\. System validates uniqueness and saves the role. The name of a default system role cannot be changed. **A10.2: Configure role permissions** 1\. Admin opens the Role Matrix. 2\. System displays the matrix of navbar features by role. 3\. Admin ticks or unticks the features of each role and saves. 4\. System stores the features of the role and derives its module permissions (read, create, update, delete, approve). **A10.3: Delete role** 1\. Admin selects Delete on a custom role and confirms. 2\. System deletes the role if no account holds it. (See E10.2) |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E10.1: Duplicate role** 1\. Cause: The role name or code already exists. 2\. Response: System displays a duplicate message (MSG09). 3\. The role is not saved. **E10.2: Role cannot be deleted or changed** 1\. Cause: The role is a default system role, accounts still hold it, or the change would remove the role screens from the Admin. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG14). 3\. The role is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-02, BR-03, BR-49 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.7 UC-18 Manage Pending Orders**

| ID and Name | UC-18: Manage Pending Orders |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | QuanDN | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Sales Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | A customer places an order by phone, Zalo or in person. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Sales Accountant to record customer orders as bookings and to view, update and cancel them. A booking reserves quantity for the customer but does not change inventory. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Sales Accountant is logged in, has the booking function and access to the processing warehouse. Accepting new bookings is enabled in the order settings. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The booking is saved (Draft or Confirmed) and its quantities are shown as "customer ordered" in the goods catalog. **Failed:** The booking is not saved and inventory is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Sales Accountant opens the POS screen and selects Add Booking (or Bookings \> Booking). 2\. Sales Accountant selects the customer and the processing warehouse. 3\. Sales Accountant adds products and quantities; the system fills the unit price from the applicable price book. 4\. Sales Accountant enters discount, expected delivery date, note and an optional advance payment. 5\. Sales Accountant clicks Save. 6\. System validates the booking (See E18.1, E18.2) and saves it with a booking code. 7\. System displays a success message (MSG10). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A18.1: View bookings** 1\. Sales Accountant opens Bookings and filters by status, customer or time. 2\. System displays the bookings; a row can be expanded to view lines, invoices and payments. **A18.2: Update booking** 1\. Sales Accountant opens a booking that has not been delivered and clicks Edit. 2\. Sales Accountant changes products, quantities, prices or information and saves. 3\. System saves the changes. (See E18.3) **A18.3: Cancel booking** 1\. Sales Accountant clicks Cancel and confirms (MSG18). 2\. If an advance payment exists, the Sales Accountant chooses to refund it or keep it as customer prepayment. 3\. System cancels the booking and releases the reserved quantity (MSG19). **A18.4: Finish booking** 1\. The customer will not take the remaining quantity of a booking in Delivering. 2\. Sales Accountant finishes the booking; the remaining quantity is released. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E18.1: New bookings paused** 1\. Cause: Accepting new bookings is turned off in the order settings. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG66). 3\. The booking is not saved. **E18.2: Invalid booking** 1\. Cause: Customer, warehouse or products are missing, or a quantity is not greater than 0\. 2\. Response: System displays a validation message (MSG01). 3\. The booking is not saved. **E18.3: Booking already delivered** 1\. Cause: An invoice has been delivered for the booking, or a prepaid booking changes customer. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG17). 3\. The booking is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-06, BR-08, BR-09, BR-11, BR-45 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.8 UC-23 Consolidate Orders & Process Sales Invoice**

| ID and Name | UC-23: Consolidate Orders & Process Sales Invoice |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | QuanDN | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Sales Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | The customer wants to receive goods of one or more bookings, or buys directly at the counter. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Sales Accountant to merge bookings of one customer and one warehouse, and to process a booking (or a direct sale) into a sales invoice on the POS screen. The payment is recorded, the credit limit is checked and stock is issued in one transaction. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Sales Accountant is logged in, has the POS function and access to the selling warehouse. The bookings are not cancelled or finished. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The invoice is Completed, stock is issued, the customer receipt and debt are updated and the booking becomes Delivering or Finished. **Failed:** No invoice is created; inventory and debt are unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Sales Accountant opens POS and selects Process Booking. 2\. System displays the open bookings of the working warehouse; the Sales Accountant selects one. 3\. System loads the customer and the remaining quantities of the booking. 4\. Sales Accountant enters the quantities actually delivered and the payment (cash or bank transfer). (See A23.2) 5\. System checks available stock and the customer credit limit. (See E23.1, A23.3) 6\. Sales Accountant clicks Pay. 7\. System creates the invoice, issues stock, records the receipt and the customer debt, and updates the booking status (MSG27). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A23.1: Consolidate bookings** 1\. Sales Accountant selects bookings of the same customer in Bookings and clicks Merge. 2\. System creates a new booking with the combined lines; the source bookings are cancelled and linked to it. (See E23.2) **A23.2: Partial delivery** 1\. The delivered quantity is lower than the remaining quantity. 2\. System shows the ordered, delivered and remaining quantities (MSG29). 3\. After payment the booking stays in Delivering with the remaining quantity. **A23.3: Credit limit exceeded** 1\. Current debt plus the new debt exceeds the credit limit (MSG22). 2\. Sales Accountant increases the paid amount or sends a credit request (UC-27) with a reason. 3\. The invoice can be paid after the Manager approves the request. **A23.4: Direct sale** 1\. Sales Accountant adds products to a new invoice tab without a booking. 2\. The flow continues from step 4\. **A23.5: Cancel invoice** 1\. Sales Accountant cancels a completed invoice in Invoices. 2\. System restores stock, reduces debt, cancels the receipt and reopens the booking. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E23.1: Insufficient stock** 1\. Cause: A quantity exceeds the available stock and negative stock is not allowed in the order settings. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG28). 3\. The invoice is not created. **E23.2: Different customers or warehouses** 1\. Cause: The selected bookings belong to different customers or warehouses. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG20). 3\. The bookings are not merged. **E23.3: Duplicate submission** 1\. Cause: Pay is clicked again while the transaction is processing. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG67). 3\. Only one invoice is created. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-10, BR-12, BR-13, BR-14, BR-16, BR-17, BR-45 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.9 UC-28 Create Sales Return**

| ID and Name | UC-28: Create Sales Return |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | QuanDN | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Sales Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | A customer returns goods that were sold. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Sales Accountant to create a return for goods of a completed invoice, or a quick return when the customer has no invoice. The return is completed when it is saved: goods are added back to inventory and the customer debt or refund is updated. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Sales Accountant is logged in, has the sales return function and access to the receiving warehouse. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The return is Completed, inventory is increased and the customer debt is reduced or the refund is recorded. **Failed:** The return is not saved; inventory and debt are unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Sales Accountant opens Sales Returns and clicks Return (or the Return tab in POS). 2\. System displays the invoice picker; the Sales Accountant selects a completed invoice. 3\. System displays the invoice lines with the quantity still returnable. 4\. Sales Accountant enters the returned quantity, the return price, the return fee and the refund amount and method. 5\. Sales Accountant clicks Return. 6\. System validates the quantities (See E28.1), saves the return, adds the goods to stock and updates the customer debt and refund (MSG32). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A28.1: Quick return without invoice** 1\. Sales Accountant selects Quick Return, the customer (or walk-in customer) and the products. 2\. The flow continues from step 4\. **A28.2: Cancel return** 1\. Sales Accountant cancels a return and confirms. 2\. System removes the returned goods from stock and reverses the debt and refund. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E28.1: Invalid return quantity** 1\. Cause: No line has a quantity greater than 0, or a quantity exceeds the returnable quantity. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG31). 3\. The return is not saved. **E28.2: Invoice not returnable** 1\. Cause: The invoice is not completed or has been cancelled. 2\. Response: System displays a message (MSG17). 3\. The return is not saved. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-19, BR-21 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

Sales Accountant searches by code, name or phone, or filters by debt, status or branch. 4\. Sales Accountant expands a customer. 5\. System displays the tabs Information, Sales/Return History, Booking History, Receivable and Credit Limit History. |  |  |

The customer debt exceeds the debt amount or the number of debt days configured in the debt-warning settings. 2\. System marks the customer and shows the warning in POS. |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.11 UC-30 Manage Purchase Orders**

| ID and Name | UC-30: Manage Purchase Orders |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Warehouse Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Goods or materials need to be ordered from a supplier. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Warehouse Accountant to create, view, update, send, merge, finish and cancel purchase orders to suppliers. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Warehouse Accountant is logged in, has the purchase order function and access to the receiving warehouse. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The purchase order is saved with its status (Draft, Ordered, Partially Received, Completed, Cancelled). **Failed:** The purchase order is not saved. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Warehouse Accountant opens Purchase Orders and clicks Purchase Order. 2\. Warehouse Accountant selects the supplier and the receiving warehouse. 3\. Warehouse Accountant adds items with quantity, unit price and discount (or adds a whole category). 4\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Save Draft or Order. 5\. System validates the order (See E30.1) and saves it. 6\. System displays a success message (MSG10). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A30.1: Update purchase order** 1\. Warehouse Accountant opens an order that has no receipt and edits it. 2\. System saves the changes. **A30.2: Merge purchase orders** 1\. Warehouse Accountant selects orders of the same supplier and warehouse and clicks Merge. 2\. System creates one order from the selected orders. **A30.3: Receive goods** 1\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Receive on an ordered purchase order. 2\. The flow continues with UC-31. **A30.4: Finish / cancel** 1\. Warehouse Accountant finishes a partially received order or cancels an order without receipt. 2\. System updates the status. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E30.1: Invalid purchase order** 1\. Cause: Supplier or items are missing, or a quantity is not greater than 0\. 2\. Response: System displays a validation message (MSG01). 3\. The order is not saved. **E30.2: Status does not allow change** 1\. Cause: The order already has a receipt. 2\. Response: System displays MSG17. 3\. The order is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-06, BR-22, BR-45 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.12 UC-31 Process Inbound Goods Receipt**

| ID and Name | UC-31: Process Inbound Goods Receipt |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Warehouse Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Goods from a supplier arrive and the checker reports the counted quantities. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Warehouse Accountant to record goods received from a supplier, with or without a purchase order. Accepted quantities are added to inventory, the moving average cost is recalculated and the supplier payable is updated. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Warehouse Accountant is logged in, has the goods receipt function and access to the receiving warehouse. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The receipt is Completed; inventory, stock card, MAC, supplier payable and the purchase order status are updated. **Failed:** The receipt is not completed and inventory is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Warehouse Accountant opens Goods Receipts and clicks Receive Goods (or Receive on a purchase order). 2\. Warehouse Accountant selects the supplier and the receiving warehouse. 3\. Warehouse Accountant enters the accepted quantity, defective quantity, unit price and discount of each item. (See A31.1) 4\. Warehouse Accountant enters the amount paid to the supplier, if any. 5\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Complete and confirms. 6\. System validates the receipt (See E31.1), adds accepted quantities to stock, recalculates MAC, updates the supplier payable and the purchase order (MSG35). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A31.1: Record defective goods** 1\. Warehouse Accountant enters a defective quantity on a line. 2\. The defective quantity is kept on the receipt; it is not added to inventory and not paid. **A31.2: Save draft** 1\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Save Draft. 2\. System saves the receipt without changing inventory. **A31.3: Return goods to supplier** 1\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Purchase Return on a completed receipt. 2\. Warehouse Accountant enters the returned quantities and return price and completes the return. 3\. System deducts stock and reduces the supplier payable or records the supplier refund. **A31.4: Cancel receipt** 1\. Warehouse Accountant cancels a completed receipt that has no purchase return or payment. 2\. System reverses the stock and payable. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E31.1: Invalid receipt** 1\. Cause: Supplier, warehouse or items are missing, or a quantity is negative. 2\. Response: System displays a validation message (MSG01). 3\. The receipt is not completed. **E31.2: Warehouse not authorized** 1\. Cause: The user has no access to the receiving warehouse. 2\. Response: System displays MSG04. 3\. The receipt is not saved. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-23, BR-24, BR-25, BR-29 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.13 UC-34 Allocate Inbound Costs**

| ID and Name | UC-34: Allocate Inbound Costs |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Warehouse Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Additional costs (freight, handling, loading...) of a purchase receipt are known. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Warehouse Accountant to enter landed costs of a completed goods receipt and allocate them to the received items by value or by quantity. The allocated cost is included in the Moving Average Cost. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Warehouse Accountant is logged in and has the landed cost permission. The goods receipt is Completed. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** Landed costs are saved, allocated to the receipt items and MAC is recalculated. **Failed:** The costs are not allocated and MAC is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Warehouse Accountant opens a Completed receipt and clicks Allocate Landed Cost. 2\. System displays the accepted items with quantity and value. 3\. Warehouse Accountant adds cost lines (cost type, amount, note). 4\. Warehouse Accountant selects the allocation method: By Value or By Quantity. 5\. System calculates the allocated amount and the new unit cost of each item. (See A34.1) 6\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Confirm. 7\. System validates (See E34.1), saves the allocation and recalculates the MAC of the affected products. 8\. System displays a success message. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A34.1: Change cost information** 1\. Warehouse Accountant edits an amount or the method before confirming. 2\. System recalculates the allocation. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E34.1: Invalid cost** 1\. Cause: Amount ≤ 0, cost type missing, or the receipt has no accepted quantity. 2\. Response: System displays a validation message. 3\. The allocation is not saved. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | Medium |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-28, BR-29, BR-45 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.14 UC-35 Process Sales Stock Issue**

| ID and Name | UC-35: Process Sales Stock Issue |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Sales Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | A sales invoice is paid on the POS screen. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature issues the sold goods from the selling warehouse at the moment the sales invoice is completed. There is no separate issue request waiting for warehouse confirmation. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Sales Accountant is logged in, has the POS function and access to the selling warehouse. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** A stock issue is recorded for the invoice; inventory is deducted by the invoiced quantity and the stock card is updated. **Failed:** Neither the invoice nor the issue is created; inventory is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Sales Accountant completes an invoice in POS (UC-23). 2\. System checks the available stock of each line (on hand minus quantities reserved by other bookings). 3\. System creates the stock issue and deducts inventory at the moving average cost. 4\. System writes the stock card lines of the invoice. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A35.1: Partial delivery of a booking** 1\. The invoiced quantity is lower than the remaining booking quantity. 2\. System issues only the invoiced quantity; the booking stays in Delivering with the remaining quantity. **A35.2: Negative stock allowed** 1\. Negative stock is enabled in the order settings. 2\. System allows the issue even if the stock becomes negative. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E35.1: Insufficient stock** 1\. Cause: The quantity exceeds the available stock and negative stock is not allowed. 2\. Response: System displays MSG28. 3\. The invoice is not created. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-15, BR-16, BR-17 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.15 UC-37 Process Stock Transfer**

| ID and Name | UC-37: Process Stock Transfer |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Warehouse Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Goods must be moved from one warehouse to another. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Warehouse Accountant to create a transfer, dispatch it at the source warehouse and confirm receipt at the destination warehouse. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Warehouse Accountant is logged in and has access to the source warehouse (create, dispatch, cancel) or the destination warehouse (receive). |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** Dispatch: the transfer is In Transit and source stock is deducted. Receipt: the transfer is Received and destination stock is increased by the received quantity. **Failed:** The transfer status and inventory are unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Warehouse Accountant opens Transfers and clicks Transfer. 2\. Warehouse Accountant selects the source and destination warehouses and adds items with quantity and transfer price. 3\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Save Draft or Complete. 4\. On Complete the system validates the transfer (See E37.1), deducts source stock and sets the status to In Transit (MSG47). 5\. The destination Warehouse Accountant opens the transfer and clicks Receive. 6\. He or she enters the received quantity of each line and the receiving note and clicks Receive. 7\. System increases destination stock and sets the status to Received (MSG48). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A37.1: Received quantity lower than transferred** 1\. A received quantity is lower than the transferred quantity. 2\. System requires a receiving note (MSG49) before receipt. **A37.2: Cancel transfer** 1\. Warehouse Accountant cancels a Draft or In Transit transfer with an optional reason. 2\. System restores the source stock if it was dispatched. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E37.1: Invalid transfer** 1\. Cause: Source and destination are the same, or the transfer has no items. 2\. Response: System displays MSG46. 3\. The transfer is not dispatched. **E37.2: Status does not allow change** 1\. Cause: The transfer is not Draft (dispatch) or not In Transit (receive). 2\. Response: System displays MSG17. 3\. No change is made. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-40, BR-41 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.16 UC-39 Conduct Stocktake**

| ID and Name | UC-39: Conduct Stocktake |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Warehouse Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | A periodic or ad-hoc physical count of a warehouse is required. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Warehouse Accountant to create a stocktake, enter the counted quantities and complete it. Completing the stocktake balances inventory to the counted quantities. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Warehouse Accountant is logged in, has the stocktake function and access to the warehouse. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The stocktake is Balanced; inventory equals the counted quantities and the variances are written to the stock card. **Failed:** The stocktake is not completed and inventory is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Warehouse Accountant opens Stocktakes and clicks Stocktake. 2\. Warehouse Accountant selects the warehouse and adds products (by search, category or Excel file). 3\. System displays the system quantity of each product. 4\. Warehouse Accountant enters the counted quantity of each line from the count sheet. 5\. System calculates the variance quantity and value of each line and the totals. 6\. Warehouse Accountant enters a note and clicks Complete, then confirms. 7\. System adjusts inventory to the counted quantities and sets the status to Balanced (MSG52). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A39.1: Save draft** 1\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Save Draft. 2\. System saves the stocktake as Draft without changing inventory; while it is Draft, production issues and receipts and disposals of its items in that warehouse are blocked. **A39.2: Merge stocktakes** 1\. Warehouse Accountant selects Draft stocktakes of the same warehouse and clicks Merge. 2\. System combines them into one stocktake. **A39.3: Cancel stocktake** 1\. Warehouse Accountant cancels a stocktake and confirms. 2\. System cancels it; a balanced stocktake is reversed. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E39.1: Invalid count** 1\. Cause: A counted quantity is negative or no product is selected. 2\. Response: System displays MSG01. 3\. The stocktake is not completed. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-42 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.17 UC-41 Process Customer Returns**

| ID and Name | UC-41: Process Customer Returns |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Sales Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Goods returned by a customer are received. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature completes a customer return: returned goods are added back to the inventory of the receiving warehouse, the customer debt is reduced and any refund is paid. It is performed together with UC-28. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | A sales return is being saved (UC-28). |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** Inventory, customer debt and refund are updated and the return is Completed. **Failed:** Nothing is updated. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. System adds the returned quantity of each line to the inventory of the receiving warehouse at the return price. 2\. System reduces the customer debt by the return value minus the return fee. 3\. System records the refund paid to the customer, if any. 4\. System displays a success message (MSG53). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A41.1: Pay refund later** 1\. Sales Accountant opens a return and clicks Refund. 2\. Sales Accountant enters the amount and method; the system records the payment. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E41.1: Warehouse not authorized** 1\. Cause: The user has no access to the receiving warehouse. 2\. Response: System displays MSG04. 3\. The return is not saved. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-19, BR-20, BR-21 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.18 UC-43 Process Inventory Disposal**

| ID and Name | UC-43: Process Inventory Disposal |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Warehouse Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Damaged, defective or expired goods must be written off. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Warehouse Accountant to create a disposal note. Completing the note deducts the disposed quantity from inventory at the moving average cost. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Warehouse Accountant is logged in, has the disposal function and access to the warehouse. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The disposal note is Completed and inventory is reduced. **Failed:** The note is not completed and inventory is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Warehouse Accountant opens Disposals and clicks Disposal. 2\. Warehouse Accountant selects the warehouse, the disposal date and the person who performs the disposal. 3\. Warehouse Accountant adds products and disposal quantities. 4\. System displays the cost and value of each line. 5\. Warehouse Accountant enters the disposal reason and clicks Complete, then confirms. 6\. System validates the note (See E43.1, E43.2), deducts inventory and sets the status to Completed (MSG55). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A43.1: Save draft** 1\. Warehouse Accountant clicks Save Draft; inventory is unchanged. **A43.2: Cancel disposal** 1\. Warehouse Accountant cancels the note and confirms. 2\. System restores inventory if the note was completed. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E43.1: Missing reason or invalid quantity** 1\. Cause: The reason is empty when completing, or a quantity exceeds the available stock. 2\. Response: System displays MSG40 or MSG54. 3\. The note is not completed. **E43.2: Item under stocktake** 1\. Cause: An item is in a Draft stocktake of the warehouse. 2\. Response: System displays MSG50. 3\. The note is not completed. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | Medium |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-42, BR-49 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.21 UC-46 Process Material Stock Issue**

| ID and Name | UC-46: Process Material Stock Issue |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Production Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Materials are taken from the warehouse to the workshop for a production order. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Production Accountant to record the materials actually issued for a production order, including supplementary issues. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Production Accountant is logged in, has the material issue function and access to the issuing warehouse. The order is Not Started or In Progress. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** Material inventory is reduced by the issued quantity, the cumulative issued quantity and shortage are updated and the order becomes In Progress at the first issue. **Failed:** Nothing is issued and inventory is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Production Accountant opens Material Issues and clicks Issue Materials. 2\. Production Accountant selects the production order and the issuing warehouse. 3\. System lists the materials with requirement, issued quantity, shortage and stock. 4\. Production Accountant enters the actual issued quantity of each material. 5\. Production Accountant clicks Save. 6\. System validates the issue (See E46.1 – E46.3), deducts stock and updates the order (MSG41). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A46.1: Supplementary issue** 1\. Production Accountant selects Supplementary Issue for an order. 2\. If the cumulative issued quantity exceeds the requirement, a reason is required (MSG40). **A46.2: Issue lower than required** 1\. Stock is insufficient; the Production Accountant enters a lower quantity. 2\. System keeps the remaining shortage (MSG39). |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E46.1: Quantity exceeds stock** 1\. Cause: The issued quantity is negative or exceeds the available stock. 2\. Response: System displays MSG28. 3\. The issue is not saved. **E46.2: Order not open** 1\. Cause: The order is Completed or Cancelled. 2\. Response: System displays MSG17. 3\. The issue is not saved. **E46.3: Item under stocktake** 1\. Cause: A material is in a Draft stocktake of the warehouse. 2\. Response: System displays MSG50. 3\. The issue is not saved. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-32, BR-33, BR-34, BR-38, BR-42 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.22 UC-49 Record Finished Goods Receipt**

| ID and Name | UC-49: Record Finished Goods Receipt |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | DatTD | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Production Accountant |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Finished goods are counted by the warehouse checker. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Production Accountant to record finished goods received into the finished goods warehouse. Good quantities are added to inventory; defective quantities are recorded on the receipt only. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Production Accountant is logged in, has the finished goods function and access to the receiving warehouse. The order is In Progress. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The good quantity is added to inventory; the order progress is updated. **Failed:** The receipt is not saved. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Production Accountant opens Finished Goods and selects the production order. 2\. Production Accountant selects the receiving warehouse and location and enters the lot, production date, good quantity, defective quantity and reason. 3\. System checks the cumulative quantity against the plan and the material usage against the issued materials. (See A49.1, A49.2) 4\. Production Accountant clicks Save. 5\. System adds the good quantity to stock and updates the order progress (MSG44). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A49.1: Quantity exceeds plan** 1\. The cumulative good quantity exceeds the planned quantity. 2\. System asks for confirmation (MSG42); the receipt is saved after confirmation. **A49.2: Material usage warning** 1\. The finished goods need more material than has been issued according to the BOM. 2\. System requires a note (MSG43) and flags the receipt for the Manager. **A49.3: Manager approves completion** 1\. The Manager clicks Approve Completion on the order and enters the actual quantities. 2\. System creates the finished goods receipt and completes the order (MSG45). |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E49.1: Item under stocktake** 1\. Cause: The finished good is in a Draft stocktake of the warehouse. 2\. Response: System displays MSG50. 3\. The receipt is not saved. **E49.2: Warehouse not valid** 1\. Cause: The receiving warehouse is inactive or not assigned to the user. 2\. Response: System displays MSG04. 3\. The receipt is not saved. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-04, BR-35, BR-36, BR-37, BR-38 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

| **Primary Actor:** | Manager |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | Master data must be created or changed. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Manager to maintain goods, categories and units, customers, suppliers, credit limits and BOM used by all business transactions. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Manager is logged in and has the master data functions. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The master data is saved. **Failed:** The system displays an error message and the data is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Manager opens the required master data screen (Goods, Customers, Suppliers or BOM). 2\. System displays the list with search and filters. 3\. Manager selects the required operation. (See A51.1 – A51.5) 4\. System validates and saves the data (MSG10). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A51.1: Manage goods** 1\. Manager creates or edits goods (code, name, type, category, unit and conversion units, selling price, cost, reorder point, images). 2\. Manager may deactivate goods, import goods from a file (UC-99) or view the stock card. **A51.2: Manage customers / suppliers** 1\. Manager creates or edits a customer or supplier and activates or deactivates it. **A51.3: Set credit limit** 1\. Manager selects one or many customers and clicks Adjust Credit Limit. 2\. Manager sets a new value or a percentage change and enters the reason. 3\. System saves the limit and the credit limit history. **A51.4: Manage BOM** 1\. Manager creates a BOM version for a finished good with materials, standard quantity and wastage. 2\. Manager activates the version; the previous active version is deactivated. **A51.5: View warehouses** 1\. Warehouses are maintained by the Admin (UC-15); storage locations are created from the goods form. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E51.1: Duplicate code** 1\. Cause: The code already exists. 2\. Response: System displays MSG09. 3\. The data is not saved. **E51.2: Data in use** 1\. Cause: The record is used by transactions or the BOM is used by production orders. 2\. Response: System displays MSG17 and suggests deactivating it. 3\. The record is not deleted. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-06, BR-18, BR-26, BR-27, BR-30, BR-48, BR-49 |  |  |
| **Other information:** | N/A |  |  |

##### **2.2.3.27 UC-72 Manage Inventory**

| ID and Name | UC-72: Manage Inventory |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | TamDM | **Date Created:** | 03/10/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Manager |  |  |
| **Trigger:** | The Manager wants to monitor inventory or an inventory approval is waiting. |  |  |
| **Description:** | This feature allows the Manager to view inventory across warehouses, monitor transfers, approve stocktake adjustments and disposals, and view reorder and expiry alerts. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | Manager is logged in and has the inventory monitoring and inventory approval permissions. |  |  |
| **Post-conditions:** | **Success:** The requested information is displayed or the approval decision is recorded and applied. **Failed:** The system displays an error message and inventory is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Normal flows:** | 1\. Manager opens Goods or Transfers. 2\. System displays inventory and transfers. 3\. Manager selects the required operation. (See A72.1 – A72.6) 4\. System processes the operation and displays the result. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A72.1: View Multi-Warehouse Inventory** 1\. System displays the stock of each product per warehouse, the customer ordered quantity and the stock card with filters. **A72.2: Track Stock Transfers** 1\. System displays transfers by status with transferred and received quantities, variance and notes. **A72.3: Approve Stocktake Adjustment** 1\. Manager opens a stocktake Waiting for Approval. 2\. System displays system quantity, counted quantity, variance, value and reason of each line. 3\. Manager selects Approve, Reject or Request Recount and enters a note. (See E72.1) 4\. Approve: the system adjusts inventory to the counted quantities and releases the suspended items. Reject: inventory is unchanged and items are released. Recount: the stocktake returns to Counting. **A72.4: Approve Inventory Disposal** 1\. Manager opens a disposal note Waiting for Approval. 2\. Manager approves or rejects with a note. (See E72.1) 3\. Approve: the system reduces inventory. Reject: inventory is unchanged. **A72.5: View Reorder Point Alerts** 1\. System displays items whose on-hand quantity is at or below the reorder point. **A72.6: View Expiry Alerts** 1\. System displays lots expiring within the configured number of days or already expired. |  |  |
| **Exception:** | **E72.1: Missing decision note** 1\. Cause: A rejection or recount request has no note. 2\. Response: System displays a validation message. 3\. The decision is not saved. **E72.2: Request no longer pending** 1\. Cause: The stocktake or disposal has already been decided. 2\. Response: System displays a message and refreshes the list. 3\. No change is made. |  |  |

No order is created. **E92.3: Plan has active orders** 1\. Cause: The plan to cancel has production orders that are not cancelled. 2\. Response: System displays MSG70. 3\. The plan is not cancelled. |  |  |
